_comment: Client chrome for the account deletion screen (app/account/delete.tsx). Registered at runtime by lib/api/accountDeletionQueries.ts with deep=true, overwrite=false, so folding these into lib/i18n/locales/en.json later is safe and makes the registration a no-op. 1:1 with account_deletion.fr.json, same {{placeholders}}. IMPORTANT: every sentence that states WHAT IS ERASED, WHAT IS KEPT, THE LEGAL BASIS and THE DATES comes from the SERVER already translated (lang/{en,fr}/account_deletion.php) and is rendered verbatim — the screen never authors a promise of its own, so the two can never drift apart. Only navigation chrome, input labels and confirmation prompts live here.
